rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for ideas or attitudes that are laughably old-fashioned.

example.english: You still say women must stay at home—your attitude is so antediluvian that it’s laughable.
example.traditional: 你仲話女人一定要留喺屋企，真係老土到笑死人。
example.jyutping: nei5 zung6 waa6 neoi5 jan2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zan1 hai6 lou5 tou2 dou3 siu3 sei2 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that an idea or attitude is no longer up to date, without necessarily mocking it.

example.english: This management method is antediluvian and no longer suits today’s workplace.
example.traditional: 呢套管理方法已經過時，唔適合而家嘅工作環境。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gun2 lei5 fong1 faat3 ji5 ging1 gwo3 si4 m4 sik1 hap6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 gung1 zok3 waan4 ging2

rows.note: Use this for people or attitudes that cling to traditional ways and resist change.

example.english: They’re so antediluvian that they won’t even try filing forms online.
example.traditional: 佢咁守舊，連網上交表都唔肯試。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 sau2 gau6 lin4 mong5 soeng6 gaau1 biu2 dou1 m4 hang2 si3
